name: Open a sub-account for a member
description:
Look up the member by member number, open their profile, start the 'Open Sub-Account' flow, fill in the product type, nickname and initial deposit, submit the form, and reach the confirmation screen. Then read the confirmation reference number.

Returns: confirmation_ref — The confirmation reference number shown on the final screen.. Possible business outcomes: member_not_found, validation_rejected.

provenance.goal: Look up the member by member number, open their profile, start the 'Open Sub-Account' flow, fill in the product type, nickname and initial deposit, submit the form, and reach the confirmation screen. Then read the confirmation reference number.

inputs.description: The sub-account product type (e.g. 'Holiday Club', 'Money Market').

inputs.name: nickname
inputs.description: A display nickname for the new sub-account.

inputs.name: initial_deposit
inputs.description: Initial deposit in dollars; the app requires at least $5.00.

outputs.name: confirmation_ref
outputs.description: The confirmation reference number shown on the final screen.
